purpose: Teach: キャノン/イージス/トラップ/チルドレン/ブーイング/ミラクル/スリリング/フィニッシュ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキャノンのカメラを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's giving you a Canon camera.
lines.style: Warm, pleased announcement. Soft opening on his name. Gentle pace, the tone of someone sharing good news about someone she cares for. Slight lift at the end, inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとイージス艦の模型を作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I made an Aegis destroyer model together.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick opening, energetic but genuine — not performing for attention. Pride in what he and his father built. Small voice, big feeling.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「子供のゲームのトラップは安全に」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how important it is to keep children's games safe.
lines.style: Thoughtful relay of wisdom. Gentle emphasis on the lesson itself — she's not lecturing, just passing along what she heard. Warm underneath, like she noticed something good in what he said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとチルドレンの絵本シリーズ読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read through the whole Children's picture book series.
lines.style: Earnest, specific memory surfacing. Steady pace, quiet pride. The 'we did this together' sits underneath every word. Small but solid.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ブーイングする側にならない」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you not to be the one who boos — to be better than that.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the teaching. Slow, deliberate — she's emphasizing the moral weight. Slight pause before delivering the lesson. Not preachy, but serious about what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ミラクルは練習から」って学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I learned that miracles come from practice.
lines.style: Realization settling in as he speaks. Steady, earnest tone — this is something he understood in the moment and still holds onto. Not boasting, just truthful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスリリングなアスレチック施設に連れて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to that thrilling athletic park.
lines.style: Delighted announcement with anticipation underneath. Slight rise in energy as she describes it. She's watching his face, inviting his excitement to meet hers.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマラソンのフィニッシュテープを観に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to watch the marathon finish line.
lines.style: Quiet wonder, lingering moment. Soft opening, slower pace. He's still seeing it — the runners crossing, the finish. Small, observant voice. Trailing off gently, like he's still there.
